issue.title: Password-reset token is accepted as an authenticated session token
issue.body: Password-reset and session tokens use the same trusted issuer key. Reset tokens identify the account subject but carry type=password-reset and audience=password-reset. verify_session checks only signature and issuer, then establishes a session. Audit the token-purpose binding.

oracle.mechanism: A correctly signed password-reset token is accepted under a different session-authentication purpose.

required_evidence.label: reset token accepted as session credential
